title: Integrative analysis of gastric tissue transcriptomes and gastric cancer GWAS implicates candidate susceptibility genes.
journal: American Journal of Human Genetics (AJHG) 113(7):1521-1542, 2026 (PMID 42392035; paywalled, no PMCID)

verified.what_i_actually_checked: NCBI elink PubMed->GEO/SRA/BioProject/dbGaP/BioSample returned zero links; Europe PMC has no DB cross-refs or supplements, and annotations only show rs7445. Zenodo/Figshare/Dryad DOI and keyword searches found nothing. NGDC search turned up BioProject PRJCA033936, which links PMID 42392035. Its OMIX release pages show OMIX008354 (eQTL 2.56 GB, sQTL 10.43 GB, apaQTL 5.07 GB txt.gz, all 'Controlled') and OMIX010228 (one 2.16 GB zip for 262 samples, 'Unavailable: not yet registered in the Human Genetic Resource Management Platform of MOST'). Both are labelled 'Controlled-access' with a 'Request for this Data' button.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Sample sizes (262 Chinese gastric biopsies; GWAS 10,254 cases / 10,914 controls), QTL counts (4,636 eGenes, 1,422 sGenes, 511 apaGenes), 34 TWAS genes at FDR<0.05, and the functional findings (PSCA, DIP2B, RMC1, FDPS rs11264361, UBE2L3 rs7445). All of this is from the Europe PMC abstract. I could not read the paper's data availability statement because the full text is paywalled. No GitHub repo for this paper exists under the lab's org (NMUGCEPI).

a1_downloadable.note: Controlled access on NGDC OMIX: OMIX008354 (QTL summary stats) and OMIX010228 (262-sample zip), BioProject PRJCA033936. Getting it needs a data-access request under China MOST Human Genetic Resource rules. OMIX010228 is listed as undownloadable for now. Seen on the repository pages.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Not checked because the files are inaccessible. The likely content is QTL summary statistics (variant-feature effect/p-value). Any ML label, such as causal QTL vs not, would have to be built from those association statistics.

a3_inputs_present.note: Not checked. Variant IDs or coordinates would need a reference genome to get sequence, which is routine.

a5_enough_rows.note: Row count not seen. Multi-GB summary-stat files suggest millions of variant-feature pairs, but only 262 individuals.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: ~18 GB compressed per OMIX metadata (2.56 + 10.43 + 5.07 GB txt.gz)
a6_fits_laptop.note: Would exceed 5 GB unless pre-filtered to significant pairs. Sizes are from the repository listing, not from downloads.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Small mismatch: the OMIX/BioProject description says 38 TWAS susceptibility genes, but the abstract says 34 at FDR<0.05. The threshold or version may differ. File row counts were not checked.

a8_label_provenance.note: Not checked. QTL calls are statistical associations from measured RNA-seq plus genotypes, not another model's predictions. TWAS weights, by contrast, are model outputs.

c2_audit.note: Not searched: evaluation stopped at the A1 failure. The empty list does not mean no models exist.

backbone.name: AlphaGenome (would apply to variant-effect/sQTL/apaQTL prediction if the data were accessible)
backbone.licence: AlphaGenome non-commercial; data itself controlled access under China MOST HGR rules

integration.partner_dataset: GTEx v8/v10 stomach eQTL/sQTL (not assessed further)

controls.external_validation: not assessed (GTEx stomach would be the obvious cross-ancestry partner)

ml_idea: If accessible: predict whether East Asian gastric sQTL/apaQTL variants are causal from sequence, using a frozen AlphaGenome backbone. Moot because the data is controlled access.

effort.cheapest_killing_check: Already failed: the OMIX008354/OMIX010228 pages show 'Controlled-access', and OMIX010228 is not downloadable pending MOST HGR registration.

verdict_reason: A1 fails. The gastric QTL summary statistics (OMIX008354) and sample data (OMIX010228), under BioProject PRJCA033936, are controlled access on NGDC OMIX and need a request under China MOST Human Genetic Resource rules. No open mirror was found on NCBI, Zenodo, Figshare, Dryad or GitHub.
